title: OTP Resend Throttle: 60-Second and 10-Per-Day Limits
description: The auth module shall reject OTP resend within sixty seconds of the last resend or beyond ten per twenty-four hours.
rationale: An unthrottled resend endpoint can be used to flood a user's inbox or exhaust the email provider's sending quota; the per-minute and per-day caps prevent both denial-of-service and harassment scenarios.
